key_insight: A multi-stage cascaded pipeline combining targeted retrieval, grounding, and LLM answer synthesis produces more faithful, evidence-backed answers to patient questions over EHRs than single-step LLM prompting.
problem_solved: Helps patients and clinicians get accurate, grounded answers from complex electronic health records by reducing hallucinations and linking responses to supporting EHR passages.
method: Document-level and passage-level retrieval to find candidate evidence from the patient's EHR.
Evidence grounding and reranking to prioritize relevant, high-confidence passages.
LLM-based answer generation conditioned on the ranked evidence with constraints to cite supporting EHR text.
impact: Provides a practical blueprint for building reliable clinical QA systems that prioritize provenance and safety—useful for applied ML teams deploying LLMs in healthcare settings.
visual_elements: Cascaded pipeline diagram (Retrieval → Reranking/Grounding → LLM synthesis) with icons for each stage
Example Q&A card showing model answer with highlighted supporting EHR excerpts and citations
Bar chart comparing grounded vs. ungrounded answer faithfulness or hallucination rate
Icon set: patient portal, EHR document, magnifying glass (retrieval), shield (safety/provenance)
paper_title: HealthNLP_Retrievers at ArchEHR-QA 2026: Cascaded LLM Pipeline for Grounded Clinical Question Answering
paper_authors: Md Biplob Hosen, Md Alomgeer Hussein, Md Akmol Masud, Omar Faruque, Tera L Reynolds
